question.text: The most susceptible compound to nucleophilic attack at the carbonyl carbon among the given bellow group is

options.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math>

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></math>

<math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi></math>

solution.text:
Amongst aldehyde & the acid derivatives, acid chloride are the most susceptible to nucleophilic attack due to strong -I effect & weak +R effect of the Cl- atom as a result of which carbonyl carbon has the highest electron deficiency. The actual order is

MeCOCl>MeCOOCOMe >MeCOOMe >MeCHO .
